items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: A warehouse filled with bizarre little items.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Puppets, a witch board, audio tapes ... a diary, and a ring box ...

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: "... To my forever love, Victoria. Here lies my lifelong secret. In the summer of 1973, I took the life of a young lady."

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Oh, sounds like an intriguing story. Those kids will love it.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Huuhh! The pity is I find no teeth here.
Outside the cabin

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Good, that'd make another trap. The cabin is more safely secured now.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Now, take these boards to the east side of the house. We need to have that direction covered as well.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Huh, huh! Damn it, what are you? Did you really draw this amount of strength and energy from this thin body?!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This is nothing compared to the training I received in the Foundation.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Blonney, it is okay to rest on the chair over there if you're feeling fatigued. Leave this to me ...
Before the kindhearted girl finishes her words, someone else takes the boards from Blonney.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Ladies, I found something in the attic. I brought them here … Hah, Vertin?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Time- ... Timekeeper?!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: It's Anne! She's safe! Good. Hmm?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: What … what's that behind her?! I didn't know there's still an army stationing here?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: No, that's a cluster of monsters. Well, you can also call it an army.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Awesome! How are we supposed to deal with them?! We are so dead!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: I … I can't run ... any further ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Good, they've set traps in front of the cabin. Sonetto!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Activate the trap. Prepare to engage!
